result.summary: Modular-Monolith architecture with 5 services on None

output.overview: The architecture modernizes a legacy VB6 banking application to a C# based system, preserving existing functionalities and business logic. It employs a modular monolith pattern to ensure maintainability and scalability while optimizing for latency and security.

services.name: UserAuthenticationService
services.responsibility: Handles user login and authentication processes.

services.name: CustomerManagementService
services.responsibility: Manages customer profiles and related operations.

services.name: TransactionProcessingService
services.responsibility: Processes deposits, withdrawals, and interest calculations.

services.name: ReportingService
services.responsibility: Generates and exports daily and monthly reports.

auto_scaling_rules: Scale out when CPU usage > 70% for 5 minutes
Scale in when CPU usage < 30% for 10 minutes
scalability.caching_strategy: Redis for session and frequently accessed data

data_flow.description: User credentials are validated against the database.
Customer profiles are retrieved and updated in the database.
Transactions are processed and recorded in the database.
Report data is fetched from the database for generation.

latency_optimizations: Use of Redis for caching frequently accessed data

trade_offs.decision: Use of modular monolith over microservices
trade_offs.rationale: Simplifies deployment and reduces overhead for a local deployment target.
Avoids cloud costs and complexity for an MVP phase.

trade_offs.decision: Use of ASP.NET Core for all services
trade_offs.rationale: Ensures consistency and leverages existing C# expertise.

legacy_system.current_logic_summary: The legacy VB6 application handles banking operations including customer management, transactions, and reporting with multiple forms and ActiveX dependencies.
key_logic_steps: User logs in via frmLogin1 and credentials are validated.
Customer profiles are managed through frmcustomer.
Transactions are processed via frmdeposit, frmwithdraw, and frmADDINTEREST.
Reports are generated using DataReport forms.
